name: CB
description: CommitmentBank (CB) is a three-class textual entailment benchmark based on naturally occurring texts. Unlike crowdsourced NLI datasets, CB focuses on discourse contexts with embedded clauses under clause-embedding predicates. The small but high-quality dataset tests entailment, neutral, and contradiction labels in naturalistic settings.
reputation: Component of SuperGLUE; small but high-quality NLI dataset; tests semantic inference in naturalistic text; human performance ~90%
notes: Introduced in 2019 as part of the SuperGLUE benchmark. Small dataset (250 test examples) drawn from naturally occurring texts including fiction, news, and correspondence. Tests models on understanding speaker commitment to embedded propositions under attitude verbs and other clause-embedding predicates. Low variance due to small size.
